summary: Master financial modeling for strategic decision making. Build 3-statement models, DCF valuations, and scenario dashboards in 5 days.
lede: Financial Modelling for Strategic Decision Making helps professionals build dynamic, Excel-based models that connect financial data with strategic action. You will learn to develop integrated three-statement models, forecast performance, assess investments, quantify risk, and test assumptions through scenarios and sensitivity analysis. The course also covers DCF valuation, WACC, cost-benefit analysis, Monte Carlo simulations, executive dashboards, and multi-year strategic roadmaps. Through hands-on modelling, you will create linked KPIs and board-ready outputs while gaining an overview of AI-assisted forecasting and Power Query automation.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for mid-to-senior professionals who build, validate, or present financial models to drive strategic decisions. It is ideal for roles that require translating data into actionable strategy, not for beginners with no finance background. Financial Analyst:

prerequisites: Prerequisites: Intermediate Excel proficiency (formulas, charts, pivot tables) and basic accounting knowledge (income statement, balance sheet, cash flow). No coding required. Pre-course prep: Review the provided Excel basics guide (1 hour) to ensure smooth lab participation. Tools: Excel (Power Query, macros, data tables) with datasets and templates provided.
